Write an algorithm to sort the following array using insertion sort.

[3, 2, 4, 1, 5]

```python
arr = [3, 2, 4, 1, 5]
for i in range(1, len(arr)):
    key = arr[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and arr[j] > key:
        arr[j + 1] = arr[j]
        j -= 1
    arr[j + 1] = key
print(arr)
```

Given two tables: instructor, department.

```sql
SELECT d.dept_name, d.budget / SUM(i.salary) AS budget_to_salary_ratio

JOIN instructor i ON d.dept_name = i.dept_name
GROUP BY d.dept_name, d.budget;
```
